statement: The project owner explicitly approved the complete current catalog contents represented by these immutable Git tree hashes, including the revised Technician II Course 1 formative items created to remove duplicate assessment phrasing while preserving the course answer-key balance.
limitations: This attestation records human content approval only; it does not supply pilot statistics or standard-setting evidence.
It does not establish production signing, security validation, deployment evidence, or runtime accessibility conformance.
Question approval does not activate an item bank or authorize production credential issuance.
Any change to an attested content tree invalidates the affected catalog approval until a new review is recorded.
